resolved_uncertainty: Jev sizing verification review confidence car0.43/bike0.23, not a contradicted claim. Independently read full FUN002f85d0 and FUN002f6c48 plus rim/tire draw-binding and matrix-scaling spans in FUN003042c8; checked FUN004af9c8 and FUN002ca758 table indexing.
rationale: Car FUN002f85d0 duplicates width intoX and ratio intoY/Z. FUN003042c8 copies the wheel frame into fStack300 before multiplying rim-only Y/Z by the profile diameter, and draws rim cc with fStack3c0 versus tire c4/c8 with fStack300. This gives rim=(2width,rimDiameter,rimDiameter), tire=(2width,rimDiameter/profile,rimDiameter/profile).

Bike FUN002f6c48 initializes front/rear basis scales from twice rest matrixY translation. FUN002f85d0 copies those scales and forcesX1. In FUN003042c8 aux+0x24*4 multipliesX with native default11d8; CHOPPER predicate picks11d4 versus11d0 for rim-onlyY/Z. Tire draw uses the earlier copied frame.
The initially noticed0.0254 path multiplies brake-frame axes and is not the rim sizing rule. It is excluded from the implementation.
Opposite car side calls FUN0023f320 with pi. That function mixes X/Zbasis vectors and preservesY, establishing the static Y-axis half turn.
limits: Approval is source-derived static scale composition only, not dynamic camber, tire deformation, physics suspension offsets, runtime shading or emulator fidelity.
Native kind and wheel joint bindings must still be validated per source; COPCAR label alone cannot choose the motorcycle branch.
